mainEntity.name: Are there any permits required for bathtub removal in Bay Area cities like San Mateo or San Bruno?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, removing an existing bathtub without altering the plumbing lines or making structural changes does not require a permit. However, if your project involves moving plumbing, reconfiguring walls, or significant electrical work as part of a larger renovation, permits would likely be necessary. It's always advisable to consult with your contractor or local building department in cities like San Mateo or San Bruno to confirm specific requirements for your project.
